summary: Duration helpers for the ms library. parseCompound sums compound durations like "1h 30m" into milliseconds and throws a TypeError on bad input. parseClock handles m:ss and h:mm:ss strings. Both are tested.
narrative: The owner asked for parseCompound on 2026-11-03. It reuses parse, is exported from src/index.ts, and has its own test file. A follow-up asked that bad input throw a TypeError that includes the input, not return NaN, because NaN once ended up in a setTimeout. The agent implemented this and fixed a Biome formatting error. A second conversation continued with parseClock for m:ss and h:mm:ss strings. It was added with its own tests and returns undefined on invalid input. The full suite passed with 100% coverage (205 tests), plus typecheck and Biome. No PR, merge or release is recorded, so the work is built and verified locally but not shown as shipped.
